title: Joining the sections: peer listening on Al-Mutaffifin 1 to 30: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 2: Al-Mutaffifin and the sifat of weakness and emphasis
source: Written for quran/y6 lesson 27 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Joining the sections rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 27. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ (١٣) كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ (١٤) كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ (١٥) ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ (١٦) ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ (١٧) كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ (١٨)

keywords.def: linking: joining sections of a surah
an echo or bounce on ق ط ب ج د when they have a sukoon
the tongue covers the roof of the mouth: ص ض ط ظ

questions.q: Practise the join 83:18 to 83:19 three times.
questions.a: Pupils join كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ straight into وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ.

questions.q: Breakout pairs: recite 83:1 to 30 to your partner; partner marks joins, qalqalah and itbaq on the checklist. The teacher visits each room.
questions.a: Each pupil recites 83:1 to 30; partner ticks joins and rules and gives one target.

questions.q: Extend: write which join is hardest for you and plan 2 minutes a day on it.
questions.a: For example: 'The join 83:24 to 25: practise daily after Fajr.'

questions.q: The best way to fix a weak join is ...
questions.a: practise the two link ayat together
options: practise the two link ayat together

questions.q: Think again: When you join two parts of a surah, where do you usually get stuck? What could help?
questions.a: At the join: the last ayah of one part and the first of the next. Practise the 'link' ayat on their own.
